item.title: Many taxi drivers remain unprepared for imminent shift in HMRC tax rules as Making Tax Digital begins in April
item.description: Circle image credit: HMRC Taxi drivers and other sole traders across the UK are weeks away from a major change in how they report their earnings to HM Revenue & Customs, with the Government’s Making Tax Digital (MTD) for Income Tax rules set to begin from April 2026. The new system will require self-employed workers turning over above £50,000 in revenue to keep digital records and submit quarterly updates to HMRC using compatible accounting software. item.title: Zoox robo-taxis to launch on Uber platform in Las Vegas this summer
item.description: Image credit: Uber Autonomous vehicle company Zoox and ride-hailing giant Uber have announced a strategic partnership that will see Zoox’s purpose-built robotaxis deployed on the Uber platform, starting in Las Vegas this summer and expanding to Los Angeles by mid-2027. Under the agreement, riders using the Uber app will have the opportunity to be matched with a Zoox autonomous vehicle on eligible trips. item.title: Wayve, Uber and Nissan sign deal to pilot robotaxi service in Tokyo using autonomous LEAF
item.description: Image credit: Wayve Wayve, Uber and Nissan have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop and pilot robotaxi services in Tokyo, with an initial deployment planned by late 2026 using autonomous Nissan LEAF vehicles operating on the Uber platform. The collaboration will see Wayve’s AI Driver integrated into Nissan’s base vehicle architecture, enabling the vehicles to operate autonomously while connecting to Uber’s ride-hailing network. item.title: TURNING HEADS: All-electric MAXiCab taxi showcased at SMMT Electrified with continued push to enter London market noted
item.description: Image credit: Allied Vehicles One of the UK’s latest black cab taxi designs will be displayed at the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders’ (SMMT) Electrified 2026 event in London this week, although the vehicle itself cannot currently operate as a licensed taxi in the capital. item.title: Cross-border taxi and PHV compliance operation finds more than a third of vehicles FAILING licence conditions
item.description: Image credit: Hertfordshire Police A joint taxi and private hire enforcement operation in Three Rivers has found more than a third of inspected vehicles failing to meet licensing conditions. item.title: Cab Direct opens new taxi showroom in Coventry to expand vehicle access for cabbies
item.description: Image credit: Allied Vehicles Cab Direct has announced the opening of a new taxi showroom in Coventry, aimed at providing taxi operators with direct access to a range of specialist vehicles including wheelchair-accessible models and purpose-adapted taxis. item.title: Are vehicle age limits still relevant for taxis and private hire vehicles in the era of Euro 6 and electric cars?
item.description: Local authorities across the UK are slowly reviewing taxi and private hire vehicle (PHV) age limits as advances in emissions standards, hybrid technology and electric vehicles challenge long standing regulatory assumptions. Vehicle age restrictions have historically been used by licensing authorities to maintain safety, reduce emissions and ensure fleets present a modern appearance. item.title: The Taxi Centre marks 25 years as first customer returns ahead of planned premises move
item.description: Image credit: The Taxi Centre The Taxi Centre, a Glasgow-based supplier of taxi and private hire vehicles, has marked 25 years supporting drivers across the UK as it prepares to move to new premises. Founded in 2001, the company has grown into one of the sector’s best-known vehicle specialists, supplying cars, financing and aftercare services to taxi and private hire drivers nationwide. item.description: Uber has launched a new premium ride option called Uber Elite, aimed at delivering a chauffeur-style travel experience for high-end customers and business travellers. item.title: CABBIE THE MOVIE: Black cab culture looks to head to the big screen in action comedy heist
item.description: Image credit: Cabbie The Movie London’s black cab trade is set to feature at the centre of a new British action heist comedy film titled Cabbie, with producers preparing to begin filming a short pilot this spring ahead of a full feature production.
